Director: Pierre Perifel  |  Duration: 96 min  |  Rating: PG

Mr. Wolf, Mr. Shark, and the rest of the gang are back. After turning heroes, a new villain forces them back into their old dangerous ways.

Cast: Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron, Awkwafina, Anthony Ramos

Director: Dean DeBlois  |  Duration: 125 min  |  Rating: PG

The live-action adaptation of DreamWorks' beloved animated classic follows Hiccup, a young Viking who forms an unlikely friendship with Toothless, a Night Fury dragon.

Cast: Mason Thames, Nico Parker, Gerard Butler, Cate Blanchett

Director: Stephen Chbosky  |  Duration: 108 min  |  Rating: PG-13

Based on the true story of Joe Scaravella, who transformed a modest Staten Island restaurant into a culinary destination by hiring Italian grandmothers as star chefs.

Cast: Vince Vaughn, Lorraine Bracco, Linda Cardellini

Director: Wes Anderson  |  Duration: 102 min  |  Rating: PG

An eccentric tycoon is contacted by his illegitimate son while planning a series of business ventures across the Middle East. Wes Anderson's signature visual style in his most intricate story yet.

Cast: Benicio del Toro, Michael Cera, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hanks

Director: Celine Song  |  Duration: 116 min  |  Rating: PG-13

An elite matchmaker in New York is torn between her ex and a new love while questioning her own beliefs about relationships and money in the city that never sleeps.

Cast: Dakota Johnson, Pedro Pascal, Chris Evans

Director: Zach Lipovsky  |  Duration: 110 min  |  Rating: R

A young woman discovers her grandmother survived a disaster decades ago by cheating death. Now death comes to collect its debt from the entire family. The franchise returns more intense than ever.

Cast: Brec Bassinger, Teo Briones, Rya Kihlstedt

Director: James Gunn  |  Duration: 132 min  |  Rating: PG-13

The first film of the new DCU introduces Clark Kent balancing life as a journalist and superhero while facing threats that endanger all of humanity.

Cast: David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan, Nicholas Hoult, Edi Gathegi

Director: Jake Schreier  |  Duration: 127 min  |  Rating: PG-13

A group of antiheroes and reformed villains is recruited for a secret mission. Yelena Belova, John Walker, Ghost, and Taskmaster form the MCU's most unexpected team.

Cast: Florence Pugh, David Harbour, Wyatt Russell, Hannah John-Kamen

Director: Gareth Edwards  |  Duration: 118 min  |  Rating: PG-13

Five years after Jurassic World Dominion, a new expedition ventures into a remote island where dinosaurs have evolved in surprising and dangerous ways.

Cast: Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Bailey, Mahershala Ali

Director: Matt Shakman  |  Duration: 130 min  |  Rating: PG-13

Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, and Ben Grimm make their MCU debut in a retro-futuristic 1960s adventure. Earth's most fantastic four face an unimaginable cosmic threat.

Cast: Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn, Ebon Moss-Bachrach

Director: Christopher McQuarrie  |  Duration: 169 min  |  Rating: PG-13

Cast: Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg
